 P union J is independent and has size 2+card(J), so compatible_card_bound first gives card(J)<=8. Equality would make it a half-density independent subset of C20. To see the rigidity, translate P union J by one. The two disjoint sets have ten vertices each and therefore cover U, so membership alternates at each step. This gives a period-two membership predicate on natural representatives; Function.Periodic.map_mod_nat reduces it to the remainder modulo two. Applying it with a vertex of P puts every vertex of D into P union J. Since J avoids D this gives D subset P, contradicting their sizes six and two. Therefore card(J)<=7 without a maximality assumption. The actual graph has 4+card(J)<=11 vertices, and even the formal indices of the zero terms satisfy 16-card(I)>=5 for I subset R.
 
-To compare this count with a graph having parts (4,7), let r=7-card(J) and form Hq by adjoining q new abstract isolates to G for 0<=q<=r, placing the new isolates in the J part. These are graph vertices, not added polygon vertices. The required padding comparison is Phi_16(G)>=Phi_16(Hr). An isolate-splitting and telescoping approach to this comparison requires Phi_15(Hq)>=0 for every q<r; those values concern the actual disconnected forests with their added isolates. The path-only theorem path_phi_nonnegative does not supply this for disconnected forests.
+Write Phi_m(K) for PathCatalanFunctional.phi(K,univ,m). Keep the same U,D,P,J,A,R and the full original graph G above; writing N(P) for all neighbours of P in C20, the condition on J is precisely J subset univ minus (D union N(P)), together with independence. Set r=7-card(J). For each 0<=q<=r, form Hq from G disjoint_union the edgeless graph on natural labels, induced on every inl(x) for x in the actual subtype R and every inr(k) for k<q. The left tags retain every original label, edge and isolate. The right tags are new graph comparison vertices; the polygon still has twenty vertices.
 
-A further independent bound Phi_16(Hr)>=29205 is required at the fixed actual covering parts (4,7). A proposed structural route is Phi_16(Hr)>=Phi_16(P9 disjoint_union 2K1), followed by evaluation of the right-hand side. The comparison must respect the fixed parts and the actual isolates. The count identity alone establishes neither the forest nonnegativity needed for isolate padding nor this extremal bound. The original same-family deficit bound 69320276, the actual C0 case and the native operation, readout, continuation and resource correspondences remain separate questions.
+The tagged copies of A and of J together with the q right tags are disjoint independent parts covering all of Hq. Their sizes are four and card(J)+q, so card(Hq)=4+card(J)+q<=11 and Hr has parts (4,7). The forest_path_order construction in `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/FiniteForestCatalan` orders the whole original forest along a path, including its disconnected components and isolates. Place the new isolated tags after that order. This gives an injective graph map to the natural-number Hasse path, so SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic.comap gives acyclicity of every Hq. Old degrees are unchanged and new degrees are zero; hence every actual degree is at most two. The same module's phi_map and phi_subtype identify the functional on these tagged induced carriers, in particular Phi_16(H0)=Phi_16(G).
+
+For q<r, apply `D5/S3/StatisticalMechanics/HardCore/IndependentPartitionDeletion.partition_delete` to the new isolated vertex inr(q) of H(q+1), with every vertex weight equal to -X in integer power series. Deleting that vertex and deleting its closed neighbourhood both leave Hq. Thus its independent-set partition series gains the factor 1-X. Multiply by the integer Catalan series and take coefficient sixteen. FiniteForestCatalan.coeff_partition_phi identifies these coefficients with the corresponding Phi values; its size hypotheses hold because card(H(q+1))<=11<=16 and card(Hq)<=11<=15. The exact step is Phi_16(Hq)-Phi_16(H(q+1))=Phi_15(Hq).
+
+Summing these steps gives Phi_16(G)-Phi_16(Hr)=sum(q<r) Phi_15(Hq). Every summand concerns the current padded graph Hq, with parameter fifteen fixed throughout. Apply `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/FiniteForestCatalan.finite_forest_phi_nonnegative` to each actual Hq, using acyclicity, degree at most two and 15>=card(Hq). All summands are nonnegative, and therefore Phi_16(Hr)<=Phi_16(G)=O for every original permitted D,P,J. This includes empty and nonmaximal J and every original isolate. If card(J)=7, then r=0, the sum is empty and the comparison is equality.
+
+A further independent bound Phi_16(Hr)>=29205 is required at the fixed actual covering parts (4,7). A proposed structural route is Phi_16(Hr)>=Phi_16(P9 disjoint_union 2K1), followed by evaluation of the right-hand side. The comparison must respect the fixed parts and the actual isolates. Isolate padding and universal forest nonnegativity supply the padding comparison, but do not establish this extremal bound or the numeric target 29205. The original same-family deficit bound 69320276, the actual C0 case and the native operation, readout, continuation and resource correspondences remain separate questions.
